Perform union, intersection, difference and symmetric difference on two sets.

Supplied answer
a = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
b = {4, 5, 6, 7}
print(a.union(b)) # a | b -> all items
print(a.intersection(b)) # a & b -> common items
print(a.difference(b)) # a - b -> only in a
print(a.symmetric_difference(b)) # a ^ b -> not common
Note: Remember the operator shortcuts: | & - ^
